paragraphs.text: The Ebony Rhino is an artifact from the time of the Great War between the Ancients and the Tolgath on Ulgrotha .

It was discovered by a goblin family in the Koskun Mountains , who used it as a bribe to Eron for a trial to end in their favor. The goblins unearthed it from deep within the Mountains, had no idea what it is or how it works, but decided it would be better to trade it to Eron as it looked pretty impressive. It was later cheated away from Eron by Chandler and Joven . Since then, Eron has sworn that if he ever catches the two thieves, their cruel punishment would be legendary.
